annotations.title: Search shared Uber or Lyft rides (Cabpool)

description: Find open cabpools on Seat Sherpa: people sharing an Uber, Lyft or Waymo going the same way and splitting the fare, often to or from an airport. Takes a pickup and a drop-off (a city, area, neighborhood or airport such as "San Francisco", "UC Davis", "SFO"; both may be in one area) and an optional date. Returns each cabpool's pickup and drop-off place, departure time (Pacific), service, spots left, an estimate of each person's share in USD and a link to join. Seat Sherpa does not book, run or charge for the ride; when nothing fits, the answer includes a link to post a cabpool.

date.description: Optional travel date, YYYY-MM-DD (Pacific). Today is 2026-11-04 (Pacific): use today or a later date, and when the person names a day without a year, the next one on or after today. Omit to list the soonest cabpools.

from.description: Pickup area or place, e.g. "San Francisco", "Davis", "LAX".

to.description: Drop-off area or place, e.g. "SFO", "Los Angeles".
